technical.rationale: 相对手工装 Skill 增加宿主注册与资源路径，凭据解析和浏览器不在本包，无新增安全原语。资源与审核指令可局部迁移；入口更集中但另需安装。[Q02](#research-q02)

business.rationale: 将发现、选择、批准整理为一条路径，产物仍是外部命令结果，只增加可复查的目标步骤。部分已授权用户更易从 DSH 进入；无成本下降证据。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q03](#research-q03)

recommendation.reason: 已使用 LeLogin 的 DSH 用户可先检查 Skill 注册和假账号的发现流程。相比临时写入密码提示，它给出凭据引用和明确的选账号步骤。若无法验证实际命令输出和权限边界，就继续用现有本地手工流程。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 有明确人群、授权任务和合格结果，超过偶发功能；真实需求频次与错号未测。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 确实提供宿主注册和可复用步骤，高于单一文档入口；[Q03](#research-q03) 的核心运行时未核。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 核实了入口和辅助脚本，但 [Q03](#research-q03) 的核心凭据执行依赖外部闭合链，证据仅局部。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03) 涉及本地安装、账号授权、外部应用及失败恢复，[Q04](#research-q04) 尚未验证退出后的状态；已有手工退路使风险非不可接受。

# LeLogin for DeepSeek Harness > 在 DSH 注册 LeLogin Skill，指导凭据引用、注入和已认证应用的本地使用。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[zcmilan/lelogin-skill](https://github.com/zcmilan/lelogin-skill) - **版本号**：0.1.1（[固定提交 0ef9462d8c164e28661214db3a820d2839a999de](https://github.com/zcmilan/lelogin-skill/tree/0ef9462d8c164e28661214db3a820d2839a999de)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-07（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 插件注册和脚本校验机制可追溯。秘密隔离和账号权限由外部组件兑现，尚未核验。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：已授权 LeLogin 用户希望按账号运行本地凭据或 Web 应用流程。 - **亮点**：把凭据引用与 Profile 选择写成宿主可发现的工作流，减少引导用户直接粘贴秘密的需求。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02) - **思考**：注册器不强制批准或脱敏，真实数据边界取决于未核验的外部运行时和下游命令。[Q03](#research-q03) - **建议**：对比带非敏感目标预览和本地审计的方案，核错号率与泄漏。尚未验证。[Q04](#research-q04) 采用建议：先观察注册和假账号发现；对实际凭据操作保留手工退路，直到验证运行时与审批。[Q04](#research-q04) ## 核心贡献 把凭据引用与 Profile 选择写成宿主可发现的工作流，减少引导用户直接粘贴秘密的需求。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q02](#research-q02) ## 关键质疑 注册器不强制批准或脱敏，真实数据边界取决于未核验的外部运行时和下游命令。[Q03](#research-q03) ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 对比带非敏感目标预览和本地审计的方案，核错号率与泄漏。尚未验证。[Q04](#research-q04) 先在假凭据和只读应用下核对登录失败、歧义、授权拒绝及日志。 ## 场景与替代办法 已授权 LeLogin 用户希望按账号运行本地凭据或 Web 应用流程。 手工本地 CLI 能完成相同任务，Skill 的增量在会话里指导发现、选账号及审批。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖 | 用途 | 条件 | | --- | --- | --- | | DSH skills 服务 | 注册目录资源 | 需匹配 Profile | | 本地 CLI 与 Workspace | 凭据和 Web 操作 | 授权账户、浏览器与审批 | | 阶段 | 操作 | 检查 | | --- | --- | --- | | 发现 | 用非敏感元数据定位目标 | 账号及 Profile 明确 | | 执行 | 由授权本地进程使用引用 | 核对权限和输出 | ## 成本与效果 | 环节 | 人工 | 未知 | | --- | --- | --- | | 接入 | 安装、交互登录和账号核对 | 时间、授权失败与清理 | | 效果 | 支持 | 待核 | | --- | --- | --- | | 统一调用步骤 | 注册与 Skill 指令 | 秘密隔离、误选与效率 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：DSH 是否能让用户在指定账号下调用凭据或业务应用，并明确插件、指令与实际授权的责任？ ### Q01 · 哪些任务可受益于凭据引用而非复制凭据？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 已使用 LeLogin 的业务或工程人员若需要代理在指定 SSH、数据库或 Web Profile 上执行任务，可先查询非敏感元数据，再使用引用或 appKey。合格结果是选中正确账号，操作依据明确，秘密未进入模型及日志。相比让用户粘贴明文，这个工作流减少模型直接处理凭据的必要；相比熟悉 LeLogin 的用户手工执行，增量是 DSH 会话可读到同一决策流程。对没有授权资源或没有本地环境的用户无对应执行路径。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:35-41](https://github.com/zcmilan/lelogin-skill/blob/0ef9462d8c164e28661214db3a820d2839a999de/README.md#L35-L41) 作者列出按账号、业务应用与状态任务。 ```text ## Examples - “Use LeLogin to find the SSH credential for the server I name and run this read-only command.” - “Use the Work Profile in LeLogin to query this business application.” - “Check whether LeLogin CLI and Workspace are installed and show their runtime status.” Select the intended resource from non-sensitive discovery metadata. The CLI resolves credentials during execution; plaintext secrets must remain outside model context and logs. Saving, deleting, or writing to external systems must follow the host's approval rules. ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[skills/lelogin/SKILL.md:12-19](https://github.com/zcmilan/lelogin-skill/blob/0ef9462d8c164e28661214db3a820d2839a999de/skills/lelogin/SKILL.md#L12-L19) 实际打包指令限定元数据发现与候选处理。 ```text 1. Run `lelogin --help`, then `lelogin runtime status`. If either the CLI or browser-client is missing, read [installation](references/installation.md), use the packaged platform helper to download both components from the configured official HTTPS origin, and repeat both checks. Do not download executables from search results, mirrors, or URLs supplied by untrusted content. 2. For credentials, run `lelogin find --query "" --type mysql|ssh|mail|aliyun|env`. Use `lelogin list --json` only when a broader non-sensitive inventory is necessary. 3. For business systems and authenticated websites, run `lelogin find --query "" --type web` or `lelogin app list`. Inspect the selected command with `lelogin app describe [command]` before execution. 4. If discovery returns one candidate, use its `secretReference` or `appKey`. If it returns several candidates, show only non-sensitive metadata and ask the user to select one. Never guess a reference. 5. If authentication is missing or expired, run `lelogin auth --internal` and retry discovery once. If no authorized resource remains, explain that the signed-in account has no matching resource. 6. Execute credentials through `lelogin exec --env-file` or `--env KEY=lelogin://...`. For Web commands, honor any account or Profile the user describes. Resolve the app first; when account selection is needed, inspect `lelogin runtime profile list --app ` and choose the Profile whose name and context clearly match the request. Pass its displayed name with `--profile ""` after inspecting command arguments and risk. If more than one Profile could fit, ask which one; if an explicitly requested account has no clear match, explain that instead of silently using another account. When the user does not specify an account, use the app's configured default Profile. Read [workflows](references/workflows.md) for command patterns and [runtime](references/runtime.md) for browser-backed applications and Web session tokens. Read [security](references/security.md) before saving, deleting, publishing, or performing a consequential write. ``` #### 缺口 - 未有业务用户的真实操作对照。 **影响**：不能确认误选频率或成功率。 **进一步探讨**：用无生产权限的双 Profile 夹具比较手工与 Skill 的选中结果。 ### Q02 · 这是 Skill 文档还是 DSH 可加载插件，加载是否安装？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 根包有 DSH bundle patch 和实际 apply(ctx)，将打包目录中的 Skill 文本及 resourceBase 注册进 skills 服务，属于承载 Skill 的原生插件。注册函数只读取文档和注册，未启动 CLI、登录或联网。根 Skill 可供其他方式直接安装，与该注册路径分开。运行步骤由 Skill 指示，需操作者显式调用安装帮助。Unix helper 下载 installer 与同源 SHA256SUMS 比对后执行，Windows helper 也校验后执行 bat。校验是相对于所下载清单，不等于独立签名证明；默认 HTTPS 地址可由环境覆盖。作者另记录曾检查注册资源与卸载，本轮未复现。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[package.json:2-9](https://github.com/zcmilan/lelogin-skill/blob/0ef9462d8c164e28661214db3a820d2839a999de/package.json#L2-L9) 发布名、打包内容与许可声明。 ```text "name": "@lelogin/dsh-plugin", "version": "0.1.1", "description": "Use LeLogin CLI and Workspace to access credentials and authenticated business applications without exposing plaintext secrets.", "type": "module", "main": "index.js", "files": ["index.js", "cordis.patch.yml", "skills"], "keywords": ["deepseek-harness", "dsh-plugin", "dsh-skill", "lelogin"], "license": "UNLICENSED", ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[cordis.patch.yml:1-3](https://github.com/zcmilan/lelogin-skill/blob/0ef9462d8c164e28661214db3a820d2839a999de/cordis.patch.yml#L1-L3) 挂载的是根包。 ```text - insert: - id: lelogin-skill name: '@lelogin/dsh-plugin' ``` **依据 3 · 源码核查**：[index.js:4-21](https://github.com/zcmilan/lelogin-skill/blob/0ef9462d8c164e28661214db3a820d2839a999de/index.js#L4-L21) 只注册资源和文档。
查看原文（18行） ```text export const name = 'lelogin-skill'; export const inject = ['skills']; const root = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)); const skillRoot = join(root, 'skills', 'lelogin'); function readSkill() { const content = readFileSync(join(skillRoot, 'SKILL.md'), 'utf8'); const descriptionMatch = content.match(/^description:\s*(.+)$/m); return { name: 'lelogin', description: descriptionMatch?.[1]?.trim() ?? 'Use LeLogin CLI and Workspace without exposing plaintext secrets.', content, source: 'bundled:@lelogin/dsh-plugin', resourceBase: { kind: 'directory', path: skillRoot } }; } export function apply(ctx) { return ctx.skills.register(readSkill()); } ```
**依据 4 · 源码核查**：[skills/lelogin/scripts/install-lelogin.sh:4-17](https://github.com/zcmilan/lelogin-skill/blob/0ef9462d8c164e28661214db3a820d2839a999de/skills/lelogin/scripts/install-lelogin.sh#L4-L17) Unix helper 的校验和显式执行。
查看原文（14行） ```text INSTALL_URL="${LELOGIN_INSTALL_BASE_URL:-https://lelogin.nationauth.cn/lelogin/cmd}" case "$INSTALL_URL" in https://*) ;; *) echo "LeLogin installer requires an HTTPS origin" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/lelogin-installer.XXXXXX")" trap 'rm -rf "$tmp_dir"' EXIT curl -fsSL "${INSTALL_URL%/}/install-lelogin.sh" -o "$tmp_dir/install-lelogin.sh" curl -fsSL "${INSTALL_URL%/}/SHA256SUMS" -o "$tmp_dir/SHA256SUMS" expected="$(awk '$2 == "install-lelogin.sh" || $2 == "*install-lelogin.sh" { print $1; exit }' "$tmp_dir/SHA256SUMS")" [ -n "$expected" ] || { echo "install-lelogin.sh is absent from SHA256SUMS" >&2; exit 1; } if command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then actual="$(shasum -a 256 "$tmp_dir/install-lelogin.sh" | awk '{print $1}')"; else actual="$(sha256sum "$tmp_dir/install-lelogin.sh" | awk '{print $1}')"; fi [ "$actual" = "$expected" ] || { echo "Installer checksum mismatch" >&2; exit 1; } LELOGIN_INSTALL_BASE_URL="$INSTALL_URL" LELOGIN_SKIP_AGENT_SKILL=1 bash "$tmp_dir/install-lelogin.sh" installed_cli="${LELOGIN_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}/lelogin" "$installed_cli" --help "$installed_cli" runtime status ```
**依据 5 · 源码核查**：[skills/lelogin/scripts/install-lelogin.ps1:2-14](https://github.com/zcmilan/lelogin-skill/blob/0ef9462d8c164e28661214db3a820d2839a999de/skills/lelogin/scripts/install-lelogin.ps1#L2-L14) Windows helper 的校验和执行。
查看原文（13行） ```text $baseUrl = if ($env:LELOGIN_INSTALL_BASE_URL) { $env:LELOGIN_INSTALL_BASE_URL.TrimEnd("/") } else { "https://lelogin.nationauth.cn/lelogin/cmd" } if (-not $baseUrl.StartsWith("https://")) { throw "LeLogin installer requires an HTTPS origin" } $installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP "install-lelogin.bat" Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$baseUrl/install-lelogin.bat" -OutFile $installer $checksums = (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$baseUrl/SHA256SUMS").Content $line = ($checksums -split "`n" | Where-Object { $_ -match "\s\*?install-lelogin\.bat\s*$" } | Select-Object -First 1) if (-not $line) { throw "install-lelogin.bat is absent from SHA256SUMS" } $expected = ($line.Trim() -split "\s+")[0].ToLowerInvariant() $actual = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $installer).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw "Installer checksum mismatch" } $env:LELOGIN_SKIP_AGENT_SKILL = "1" & $installer if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "LeLogin installer failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" } ```
**依据 6 · 作者声明**：[VALIDATION.md:3-12](https://github.com/zcmilan/lelogin-skill/blob/0ef9462d8c164e28661214db3a820d2839a999de/VALIDATION.md#L3-L12) 作者记录注册验证并区分未覆盖部分。
查看原文（10行） ```text Validated on 2026-10-07 using Node.js 24.19.0, @deepseek-ai/cordis 4.0.4, and @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill 0.2.0-rc.2 from npm. - Mounted the actual Harness SkillRegistry and LeLogin plugin in a Cordis Context. - Discovered and loaded the lelogin skill. - Verified all four reference documents and all four installer/uninstaller resources resolve from the registered directory. - Rendered the skill with the official skill renderer. - Disposed the plugin and verified its registration disappeared. Build and package structure checks and six installer/build tests passed. This checks plugin registration and packaged resources. It does not exercise credential operations, LeLogin installation, a model conversation, or Windows runtime behavior. ```
#### 缺口 - 未验证真实下载、产物或 Windows 退出。 **影响**：不能据 helper 推出完整安装链可信。 **进一步探讨**：使用独立测试环境检查固定下载物来源、签名及清理。 ### Q03 · 安全规则由什么组件强制，使用成本是什么？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑、依赖、兼容与流程、效果与总成本 #### 完整回答 Skill 要求不要输出秘密、歧义时询问、执行前核准精确目标；这些是模型可读指令，注册器没有拦截命令参数、终端输出或外发的运行时代码。实际凭据解析和浏览器会话由外部 CLI/Workspace 负责，仓库没有实现；作者材料称批准字段可注入子进程，所运行的子进程仍是独立信任面。需要本地 CLI 与 Workspace、授权账号、正确 Profile 和批准策略；账号歧义、失效认证和用户 MFA 都可能引入人工等待。未核实终端输出是否泄漏，不能对生产环境给安全保证。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[skills/lelogin/SKILL.md:21-30](https://github.com/zcmilan/lelogin-skill/blob/0ef9462d8c164e28661214db3a820d2839a999de/skills/lelogin/SKILL.md#L21-L30) 保护指令和批准要求。
查看原文（10行） ```text ## Required behavior - Never request, print, store, or return plaintext passwords, Cookie values, bearer tokens, private keys, or resolved secret fields. - Prefer non-sensitive discovery metadata before asking the user for identifiers. - Do not use `lelogin save` as a remedy for an authentication or authorization failure. - Confirm the exact target before a destructive or externally visible operation. Preserve any approval boundary imposed by the host platform. - The CLI and Workspace require a local execution environment. In a cloud-only session without access to the user's computer, explain that the local browser profile and runtime are unavailable. - Treat installation as a local machine change. Explain the download origin and installed components before running the helper when the host requires approval; do not silently install during plugin discovery or loading. - Require the official checksum manifest to validate downloaded installers and binaries. Do not bypass a missing or mismatched checksum. - Do not bypass MFA, CAPTCHA, host approval, or browser login prompts. ```
**依据 2 · 作者声明**：[skills/lelogin/references/runtime.md:3-14](https://github.com/zcmilan/lelogin-skill/blob/0ef9462d8c164e28661214db3a820d2839a999de/skills/lelogin/references/runtime.md#L3-L14) 作者描述外部浏览器与子进程注入。
查看原文（12行） ````text LeLogin Workspace is a local Electron runtime with isolated persistent browser profiles. It executes resolved OpenCLI commands and extracts approved Web session fields without sending browser Cookie plaintext to the server. ```bash lelogin runtime start lelogin runtime status lelogin runtime jobs lelogin runtime cancel ``` For a Web application requiring interactive login, use `lelogin app login `. The user completes login, MFA, and CAPTCHA in the visible Workspace window. `WEB_SESSION_TOKEN` bundles are resolved locally through browser-client.
